subject: Vrooli

intro_text_excerpt: Vrooli is a platform where AI agents build the software. Not 'an AI helps you write code' — agents own scenarios end-to-end, raise decisions, ship work, and the system uses what they build to build more. I run it; the agents do most of the actual building.
